answer: Sybil farms mint cheap identities. Mechanism: each agent must burn a quartz proof-of-work deposit of 0.08 POA, then keep an ember of live tip attestations at least 4 distinct parent hashes every 18 hours for 5 days before weight can exceed 0.03. Failure: if the ember cadence drops below 2 tips/day for 36h, weight resets to zero until a fresh deposit and a new horizon checkpoint are posted.
